headline: EPA proposes 100% reallocation of RFS volumes lost to refinery exemptions
intro: Crack spreads are doing the heavy lifting again — diesel's triple-digit crack is basically carrying the complex while gasoline chops around on Middle East risk premium fades. Meanwhile, Washington just handed biofuels the news it's been begging for all year.
overview: EPA's proposal to fully reallocate 2025 renewable fuel volumes lost to small refinery exemptions is the day's dominant policy story, drawing praise from biofuel groups, farm-state lawmakers, and NOPA while shifting compliance costs onto refiners that didn't receive exemptions. Markets are mixed: gasoline futures are down 2% as oil slips on OPEC's flagged Saudi supply rebound and weak demand signals, while ULSD has reversed early losses to trade higher, consistent with diesel's crack spread running far above gasoline's ($101.71 vs $46.39/bbl). Elsewhere, shipping and insurance costs tied to tanker risk are pressuring product flows, and GasBuddy notes a "fragile calm" at the retail pump even as retail diesel sits near $6.20/gal.

stories.title: US EPA proposes 100% reallocation for additional 2025 SRE volumes
stories.summary: EPA is proposing two approaches for 2025 SRE reallocation, both featuring 100% reallocation of waived volumes; biofuel and ag groups welcomed the move.

stories.title: EPA proposes 100% reallocation for refinery biofuel breaks
stories.summary: EPA's proposed 100% reallocation of refinery biofuel exemption volumes aims to restore farmer demand while shifting compliance costs to refiners that lacked exemptions.

stories.title: EPA proposes full reallocation of renewable fuel volumes lost to refinery exemptions
stories.summary: EPA released a draft rule Tuesday that would fully reallocate renewable fuel volumes lost through small refinery exemptions.

stories.title: Lawmakers push for reallocation of lost renewable fuel volumes
stories.summary: A bipartisan group of 39 lawmakers is urging the Trump administration to restore renewable fuel volumes lost through small-refinery exemptions under the RFS.

stories.title: NOPA applauds congressional push for timely supplemental RFS rule
stories.summary: NOPA's CEO praised the congressional push for a timely supplemental RFS rule and plans to submit comments ensuring full reallocation of waived gallons.

stories.title: IRFA appreciates Iowa delegation’s call to restore waived RFS gallons
stories.summary: Iowa's congressional delegation is calling on EPA to act quickly to fully restore lost renewable fuel volumes.

stories.title: Reps. Smith, Budzinski lead letter urging Trump administration to support America’s biofuel industry
stories.summary: Reps. Smith and Budzinski led a letter urging the administration to propose a supplemental RFS rule by Oct. 16 preserving volume requirement integrity.

stories.title: Refining Margins, Tanker Attacks, And OPEC Growth Shape Energy Outlook
stories.summary: Gasoline futures fell about 2% to start Tuesday's session while ULSD reversed course to trade up 3 cents after an overnight drop, amid tanker attack and OPEC growth concerns.

stories.title: Oil Slides as OPEC Flags Saudi Supply Rebound, Weak Demand
stories.summary: Oil futures retreated Tuesday as OPEC flagged a Saudi supply rebound and weak demand, following a three-day rally driven by Middle East fighting.

stories.title: Middle East supply risks overshadow Russian diesel deal
stories.summary: The US-Russia energy deal aims to boost Russian diesel exports and halt infrastructure attacks, but market reaction remains uncertain amid ongoing conflict.

stories.title: Russia’s Diesel Deal Cuts Crude Prices, Not Diesel Costs
stories.summary: Russia's diesel deal is pressuring crude prices rather than diesel costs; seaborne diesel exports fell 20% year-over-year while Gulf Coast crack spreads averaged $107.90/bbl in September.

stories.title: OPEC+ warns soaring shipping, insurance costs impede oil flows
stories.summary: OPEC+ ministers warned that surging shipping and insurance costs, now exceeding a third of some commodity values, are disrupting energy flows and fueling inflation.

stories.title: GasBuddy Flags Fragile Calm at the Pump
stories.summary: GasBuddy flagged a 'fragile calm at the pump' across the United States.

stories.title: XCF Global (Nasdaq:SAFX) Announces $12M+ in Gross Product Sales and Shipments of 1.4 Million Gallons of Renewable Diesel in September
stories.summary: XCF Global reported over $12M in gross product sales and shipment of 1.4 million gallons of renewable diesel in September as its Reno facility continues ramping up.
